paragraphs: R' Shmuel bar Yonah — see the entry R' Shmuel bar Unya.[^1]

notes.text: Yonah (יונה) and Unya (אוניא) remain different supplied patronymics. The current Unya vocalization is retained; both abbreviated titles remain R'.
